tolerance_origin: project engineering acceptance targets for named smooth scaled fixtures only; not guarantees for arbitrary inputs

analytic_harmonic.numeric_reference: Independent closed-form sin/cos, not a second VV loop or the production force evaluator; use independently checked high-precision reference if binary64 trig uncertainty approaches gate.

cases.name: free ballistic
cases.criterion: all integer-step q=r0+v0*t and v=v0, F=0, E/P/L and COM; scaled component errors<=1e-12; zero initial reference uses absolute scales

cases.name: unequal mass noncollinear harmonic exact
cases.criterion: all integer-step max q/L0 and v/V0 error<=1e-6; max E drift/E0<=1e-6; P/P0,L/J0,COM/L0 drift error<=1e-10

cases.name: second-order convergence
cases.criterion: sameT1; h=.05,.025,.0125,n=20,40,80. e_h=max all common coarse integer-step q/v absolute scaled exact error. Both log2(e_h/e_h2) in[1.8,2.2], finest exact error<=1e-4. Zero/roundoff-dominated reference -> indeterminate, not an order pass.

cases.name: symmetries and units
cases.criterion: rigid rotation/translation+corresponding initialconditions, ID permutation, consistent L0/E0/T0 and potential-coefficient conversion retain SI q/v/F within1e-9 scaled; momentum/angular quantities transformed with correct origin, not blindly identical

cases.name: reversibility supplementary
cases.criterion: harmonic h=.001,n1000, then reverse final full-step velocities and integrate same positive h,N; q returns to initial, v to negative initial within1e-9 scaled. Supplement only, never substitutes exact/refinement gates.

cases.name: all-step diagnostics vs sparse samples
cases.criterion: sample_stride1 vs10 must leave numerical decision and diagnostic maxima unchanged; only output sample list differs; exact initial and terminal sample retained

cases.name: domain and drift crossing
cases.criterion: initial coincident/min-distance/log/sqrt/range failure has no payload; free pair at x=[-1,0,0],[1,0,0],v=[2,0,0],[-2,0,0],h=1 crosses between safe endpoints and must fail drift guard; last accepted state only, no reflection or clipping

cases.name: resource and strict schema
cases.criterion: missing/negative/zero masses, missing velocity, fixed fields, unsupported boundary/solver/time dependent field, duplicate IDs, invalid stride/time grid, all budgets including refinement and terminal frame, unknown keys/versions rejected; no workload auto reduction

cases.name: phase/time/hash/persistence
cases.criterion: effective state includes time; output envelope physical_time matches state; arrays IDs/masses aligned; old static and replay hashes retained; unregistered draft rejected by active0.2; standalone input immutable; artifact hashes and byte limits actual

cases.name: cancel and failed refinement
cases.criterion: cancel publication race, hard process stop and no fabricated partial; h2/h4 failure cannot yield successful primary-only operation; no downstream promotion of incomplete state

cases.name: integration/regression and native runtime
cases.criterion: existing static+relax+quantum/workflow/auth/quota regression, newbundle package+resolver hashes, locked CPython3.12.14 x86/ARM numerical fixture evidence, actual API+UI trajectory parity before deployment claim
